scope: Five optimized capsules per arm with G1-sized palm proxies manually relocated in Astro wrist-yaw frames. All 40 non-arm colliders retained; both shin capsules and the upper pelvis cylinder have maintainer joint-stop calibration. Other 37 non-arm definitions and all contact masks remain unchanged.
supersedes: The prior whole-body 27-collider experiment, six-proxy-per-arm revision and oversized full-hand mesh envelope; current geometry keeps all non-arm colliders and uses five proxies per arm.
contact_policy: Original non-arm automatic contacts preserved. Optimized arm masks are zero and scene_simplified.xml declares selected arm contact pairs.
preserved: All body/inertial/joint/passive/numerical properties and all 37 visual meshes/colors
37 source non-arm collider definitions; all 40 non-arm collider names, body attachments and contact parameters. Both shins and upper pelvis cylinder have manual geometry adjustments.
Original default/articulated model files, source evidence, assets and previews
limitations: No measured runtime speedup or hardware contact calibration is claimed.
Merged forearm/pitch proxies retain the source collision envelope and can contact earlier than narrower source shaft segments.
Palm contact approximation only: extended fingers and thumb can lie outside the compact capsule and do not receive separate colliders. Full native-hand mesh containment is intentionally not a goal.
No MJX runtime, PD/controller, URDF or Workbench support is introduced.

Maintainer right-forearm radius .045 leaves up to approximately 3.82 mm sampled uncovered distance on the removed wrist-roll shell; full shell containment is no longer claimed on that side. The default model retains its original wrist-roll collider.

verification.wrist_roll_union: Axially symmetric cross-section check against forearm and wrist-pitch proximal sphere; articulated pose checks also performed.
verification.hand_mesh: The compact G1 capsule approximates palm contacts; extended native fingers/thumb are intentionally outside. Previous 100% native-hand mesh containment is historical and does not apply.
verification.shoulder_yaw_merge: Source upper-arm capsule is collinear with shoulder yaw; retained merged shaft remains invariant under that rotation.
verification.wrist_hand_merge: Fixed hand and yaw housing follow wrist-yaw; wrist-pitch remains an independent proxy.
verification.palm_refinement_xml_scope: Only size and fromto on left/right_wrist_hand_collision differ from baseline 7a34149a15e8eb4fa5ccfce3e9147e686038e077; all other XML and scene pairs are unchanged.
verification.palm_native_forward_and_steps: Reference pose, each wrist joint limit and eight combined wrist extremes: finite forward state and 10 native steps each without warnings. These uncontrolled smoke checks do not establish standing stability.
verification.palm_contact_probe: Selected left palm-to-torso explicit pair generates a condim=1 contact; reference and wrist-limit poses have no initial contacts.
verification.status: Historical measurements at compact-palm commit 846b744, before manual palm/shin/pelvis adjustments. Current verification: ../../docs/astro-manual-collider-verification.md.

wrist_hand_refinement.use: G1 box-feet palm radius and length retained; maintainer later translated the capsule +0.05 m along wrist-yaw x. Current centerline x=.10 to .15 m.
wrist_hand_refinement.removed_shell_coverage: In the elbow frame, forearm capsule radius .054 and endpoint x=.09 plus the wrist-pitch proximal sphere at x=.161/radius .045 contain the removed wrist-roll capsule (axis x=.120..141, radius .034), independent of wrist orientation.
wrist_hand_refinement.tradeoff: Capsule centerline is 50 mm; total axial extent is 150 mm. Palm-only contact proxy follows the requested G1 shape. Extended fingers/thumb are intentionally not fully covered; all visual meshes are unchanged.

historical_rejected_full_hand_fit.status: Rejected as too large by user; retained here only as historical measurement, not current geometry or a current containment claim.

new_hand_geometry.frame: Each side wrist-yaw frame; identical geometry with zero lateral/vertical offsets.

manual_collider_calibration.owner: Maintainer manual XML edits; preserved byte-for-byte during verification.
manual_collider_calibration.deep_flexion: No added interference relative to the same model with shin proximal z=0; pre-existing thigh/shin contact starts at approximately 2.32697 rad (133.3 degrees).
manual_collider_calibration.limits: Native limits unchanged. Contacts and native limits are compliant; high-speed overshoot remains possible.

default_model_propagation: Palms, shins, upper pelvis cylinder and wrist-pitch capsules copied to astro_p2.xml; see ../../docs/astro-default-collider-propagation.md. The source model XML was preserved.
